titleText: JTF News: The Guardian, BBC News
mainText: A journalist in Costa Rica was killed by gunmen; the journalist had reported on the drugs trade.
President Trump stated he takes a possible Iran bomb threat to Washington seriously.

titleText: JTF News: ABC News Australia, Deutsche Welle
mainText: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will attend ASEAN and Quad meetings in Manila.
The Crimea bridge closed following a reported strike, and Russia conducted attacks on Kyiv crossings.
President Trump begins Asia tour before scheduled talks with President Putin and President Xi in China.
